targetTexts.1: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Doe of the Dawn.” A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?
targetTexts.2: I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.
targetTexts.3: Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
targetTexts.4: In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.
targetTexts.5: They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.
targetTexts.6: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.
targetTexts.7: All who see me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads:
targetTexts.8: “He trusts in the LORD, let the LORD deliver him; let the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him.”
targetTexts.9: Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me secure at my mother’s breast.
targetTexts.10: From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.
targetTexts.11: Be not far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.
targetTexts.12: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
targetTexts.13: They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.
targetTexts.14: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.
targetTexts.15: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You lay me in the dust of death.
targetTexts.16: For dogs surround me; a band of evil men encircles me; they have pierced my hands and feet.
targetTexts.17: I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.
targetTexts.18: They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.
targetTexts.19: But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.
targetTexts.20: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.
targetTexts.21: Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me!
targetTexts.22: I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.
targetTexts.23: You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All descendants of Jacob, honor Him! All offspring of Israel, revere Him!
targetTexts.24: For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.
targetTexts.25: My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.
targetTexts.26: The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!
targetTexts.27: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
targetTexts.28: For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.
targetTexts.29: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him—even those unable to preserve their lives.
targetTexts.30: Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.
targetTexts.31: They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn—all that He has done.
